title: Aptera Motors Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Aptera Motors Corp filed an 8-K disclosing settlement of litigation with Zaptera USA Inc., resulting in the issuance of 105,000 shares of Class B common stock and warrants to purchase 210,000 additional shares at $2.78 per share. All claims in the lawsuit (filed August 2024, amended multiple times) were dismissed with prejudice on April 9, 2026.
key_points: Aptera Motors Corp (ticker: SEV, listed on Nasdaq Capital Market) entered settlement agreement with Zaptera USA on April 8, 2026
Company issued 105,000 shares of Class B common stock as part of settlement consideration
Warrants issued to purchase up to 210,000 shares of Class B common stock at $2.78 exercise price
Lawsuit originally filed by Zaptera in August 2024 in U.S. District Court for Southern District of California
All claims dismissed with prejudice on April 9, 2026 via joint stipulation of parties
Issuance exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) of Securities Act of 1933
